doubts.claim_under_doubt: a scenario process can never reach a real gh or the network
doubts.disproof_attempt: On Windows CreateProcess finds gh.exe through the parent PATH and ignores the shim; several unseamed scripts call bare gh; uv and urllib children are not fenced.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: PARTLY RESOLVED in 472a9ea: GH_HOST=gh.invalid, empty GH_CONFIG_DIR and empty user home, the GitHub CLI's own PATH folder dropped, claim narrowed to git in the docstring. RESIDUAL (disclosed): on Windows a bare unseamed gh.exe is still found through the parent PATH; the P2b replay driver must route every gh through the seam and assert no gh call outside the argv log.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a wrong tag target or an extra commit always changes the trace
doubts.disproof_attempt: Refs were subject@depth only and only the first-parent line of HEAD was walked: an amend after tagging, or an extra commit on a merged and deleted branch, left the trace unchanged.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED in 472a9ea: every ref target carries a digest of the commit's changed paths, and all_commits lists every commit reachable from any ref of the repo and of origin; two tests added.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the freeze cannot be bypassed by a normal diff
doubts.disproof_attempt: A diff may re-pin a trace and its lock hash, write an approved delta with any approver, or weaken the checker file; a trace under a subfolder escaped the check.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: PARTLY RESOLVED in 472a9ea: the checker file is a required lock member and traces are found recursively. RESIDUAL (accepted, written in the test docstring, handed to the operator procedure): re-pinning and self-approval need a sensitive-path rule or CODEOWNERS on the lock and deltas paths; no test can stop them.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the environment is hermetic and runs are reproducible across machines
doubts.disproof_attempt: The real HOME leaked profile resolution and an operator key file path.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED in 472a9ea: HOME, USERPROFILE and XDG_CONFIG_HOME point at an empty directory inside the scratch; a test checks Path.home() of a child.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: byte-identical traces on Windows and Linux
doubts.disproof_attempt: The Git Bash form of a path (/c/Users/...) was not normalized; Path.glob is case-insensitive on Windows only.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: PARTLY RESOLVED in 472a9ea: the Git Bash path form is normalized and tested. RESIDUAL (low): file globs for the files option follow the platform's case rule.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the stub refuses rather than guesses
doubts.disproof_attempt: Unknown long valued flags leaked their value into the positionals.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: RESOLVED in 472a9ea: a long flag outside the per-command list is refused (exit 2); the timeout-kill gap is documented.
